note: The decoded AV1 frame dimensions from the input determine frame_size and therefore external_frame_size requested from the frame-buffer callback.
The safety obligation for the vulnerable path is that a newly allocated internal frame buffer must be initialized before later border filtering reads padding bytes.
The frame buffer memory returned by the callback becomes the YV12 buffer storage used as the decoded frame planes.

code: av1_setup_dst_planes(planes, cm->seq_params->sb_size, frame_buffer, mi_row, mi_col, plane, plane + num_planes);
note: Loop filtering sets plane destination pointers from the same frame buffer, including border-adjacent plane addresses.
The horizontal loop filter reads pixels around p; for edge blocks this includes frame-border bytes that are uninitialized if the buffer was not zero-filled.
